class.name: AudioStreamPlayer
class.description: The [AudioStreamPlayer] node plays an audio stream non-positionally. It is ideal for user interfaces, menus, or background music. To use this node, [member stream] needs to be set to a valid [AudioStream] resource. Playing more than one sound at the same time is also supported, see [member max_polyphony]. If you need to play audio at a specific position, use [AudioStreamPlayer2D] or [AudioStreamPlayer3D] instead.

method.name: crossfade_to
fade_in
method.description: Raises the fade gain to [code]1.0[/code] over [param duration] seconds and emits [signal fade_finished] at the end. If the player is not playing, playback starts from the beginning at gain [code]0.0[/code], so the first audio block is silent. The fade gain multiplies the volume of the playbacks on top of [member volume_db], which keeps its value. The gain is updated once per frame and [AudioServer] ramps it over each mix block, so fades do not click. A [param duration] of [code]0.0[/code] applies the gain in the next frame.

method.name: fade_out
method.description: Lowers the fade gain to [code]0.0[/code] over [param duration] seconds and emits [signal fade_finished] at the end. If [param stop_at_end] is [code]true[/code], playback stops when the fade ends; otherwise it keeps playing muted until [method fade_in] or [method play]. Does nothing if the player has no playback.

method.name: get_current_track_index
method.description: Returns the index of the track that is playing in the list of an [AudioStreamPlaylist] (as in [member AudioStreamPlaylist.streams]), [code]0[/code] for other streams, or [code]-1[/code] if the player has no playback or the playlist has ended.

method.name: get_current_track_stream
method.description: Returns the stream of the track that is playing: an entry of an [AudioStreamPlaylist], or [member stream] itself for other streams. Returns [code]null[/code] if the player has no playback.

method.name: get_fade_gain
method.description: Returns the current fade gain, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. It is [code]1.0[/code] unless [method fade_in], [method fade_out] or [method crossfade_to] changed it, and [method play] resets it to [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: get_playback_position
method.description: Returns the position in the [AudioStream] of the latest sound, in seconds. Returns [code]0.0[/code] if no sounds are playing. [b]Note:[/b] The position is not always accurate, as the [AudioServer] does not mix audio every processed frame. To get more accurate results, add [method AudioServer.get_time_since_last_mix] to the returned position. [b]Note:[/b] This method always returns [code]0.0[/code] if the [member stream] is an [AudioStreamInteractive], since it can have multiple clips playing at once.

method.name: get_position_in_playlist
method.description: Returns the position in seconds since the start of an [AudioStreamPlaylist], in the current play order (with [member AudioStreamPlaylist.shuffle], the shuffled order), or [method get_playback_position] for other streams. Returns [code]0.0[/code] if the player has no playback. To jump to a time in the playlist, use [method seek]: the playlist finds the track at that time and starts it at the offset. A seek reshuffles a shuffled playlist. To start a given track (without shuffle), seek to [method AudioStreamPlaylist.get_stream_start_time].

method.name: get_stream_playback
method.description: Returns the latest [AudioStreamPlayback] of this node, usually the most recently created by [method play]. If no sounds are playing, this method fails and returns an empty playback.

method.name: get_track_position
method.description: Returns the position in seconds inside the current track of an [AudioStreamPlaylist], or [method get_playback_position] for other streams. Returns [code]0.0[/code] if the player has no playback.

method.name: has_stream_playback
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if any sound is active, even if [member stream_paused] is set to [code]true[/code]. See also [member playing] and [method get_stream_playback].

method.name: is_fading
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a fade or the fade-out part of a crossfade is running.

method.name: play
method.description: Plays a sound from the beginning, or the given [param from_position] in seconds.

method.name: seek
method.description: Restarts all sounds to be played from the given [param to_position], in seconds. Does nothing if no sounds are playing.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops all sounds from this node.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], this node calls [method play] when entering the tree.

The target bus name. All sounds from this node will be playing on this bus. [b]Note:[/b] At runtime, if no bus with the given name exists, all sounds will fall back on [code]"Master"[/code]. See also [method AudioServer.get_bus_name].
The maximum number of sounds this node can play at the same time. Calling [method play] after this value is reached will cut off the oldest sounds.
The mix target channels. Has no effect when two speakers or less are detected (see [enum AudioServer.SpeakerMode]).
The audio's pitch and tempo, as a multiplier of the [member stream]'s sample rate. A value of [code]2.0[/code] doubles the audio's pitch, while a value of [code]0.5[/code] halves the pitch.
The playback type of the stream player. If set other than to the default value, it will force that playback type.
If [code]true[/code], this node is playing sounds. Setting this property has the same effect as [method play] and [method stop].
Interval in seconds at which [signal position_changed] is emitted while playing. [code]0.0[/code] turns the signal off and costs nothing per frame.
The [AudioStream] resource to be played. Setting this property stops all currently playing sounds. If left empty, the [AudioStreamPlayer] does not work.

If [code]true[/code], the sounds are paused. Setting [member stream_paused] to [code]false[/code] resumes all sounds. [b]Note:[/b] This property is automatically changed when exiting or entering the tree, or this node is paused (see [member Node.process_mode]).

Overrides [member AudioStream.subtitle_path] of the [member stream] for a [SubtitlePlayer] that syncs with this player. If empty, the [SubtitlePlayer] uses the subtitle of the stream. This is only a path: nothing is loaded until a [SubtitlePlayer] uses it.

Volume of sound, in decibels. This is an offset of the [member stream]'s volume. [b]Note:[/b] To convert between decibel and linear energy (like most volume sliders do), use [member volume_linear], or [method @GlobalScope.db_to_linear] and [method @GlobalScope.linear_to_db].

Volume of sound, as a linear value. [b]Note:[/b] This member modifies [member volume_db] for convenience. The returned value is equivalent to the result of [method @GlobalScope.db_to_linear] on [member volume_db]. Setting this member is equivalent to setting [member volume_db] to the result of [method @GlobalScope.linear_to_db] on a value.

signal.name: fade_finished
signal.description: Emitted when a fade started by [method fade_in], [method fade_out] or [method crossfade_to] has reached its target gain.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted when a sound finishes playing without interruptions. This signal is [i]not[/i] emitted when calling [method stop], or when exiting the tree while sounds are playing.

signal.name: playing_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the player starts playing ([method play], also when [method crossfade_to] or [method fade_in] start it), stops ([method stop], [method fade_out] with stop at the end, or setting a new stream), finishes (before [signal finished]), or is paused or resumed ([member stream_paused], also when the scene tree pauses it). [param playing] is the new state. It is not emitted for the internal restart of [method seek] or of a monophonic stream. It is emitted after playback started, so [member playing] is already [code]true[/code] in a handler.

signal.name: position_changed
signal.description: Emitted every [member position_signal_interval] seconds while playing, with the value of [method get_track_position]. Off by default.

signal.name: stream_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [member stream] is set to a different stream, also by [method crossfade_to].

signal.name: track_changed

constants.constant: The audio will be played only on the first channel. This is the default.
